Hate speech cases against Raja Singh repeatedly falter in court

Multiple hate speech cases filed against politician Raja Singh have consistently failed to proceed to conviction. Legal experts and reports suggest a pattern of cases collapsing due to various factors, including insufficient evidence or procedural issues. This recurring outcome raises questions about the effectiveness of legal action against hate speech in India.
